response.answer: Kestrel Bank had the most technical payment failures in September 2026. The failures were heavily concentrated on September 17 and 18. The worst hours were Sept 17 at 21:00 (56 failures), Sept 17 at 14:00 (51), Sept 18 at 20:00 (46), and Sept 17 at 12:00 (42). Nearly every hour from roughly 08:00 to 23:00 on those two days shows elevated failures (often 20-56 per hour), suggesting a significant technical incident or outage across Sept 17-18. On other days, failures were much lower, typically around 9-15 per hour and clustered in the evening (about 19:00-22:00). Note: the result shows only the top 50 date/hour combinations, so it reflects the peak periods rather than a complete month total, and the overall count per bank was used only to pick Kestrel Bank (the totals themselves were not shown).
